mode_forms.s_setreg_imm32_b32: hwreg(HW_REG_WAVE_MODE, 0|4, 4), imm (0 <= imm <= 0xF: immediate limited to the 4-bit field)
mode_forms.not_supported: VGPR_MSB, FP16_OVFL, SCALAR_PREFETCH_EN, REPLAY_MODE, FLAT_SCRATCH_IS_NV, DISABLE_PERF, any other hwreg or bit range, hwreg aliases (HW_REG_MODE, numeric ids), s_set_vgpr_msb

verifier_extra_wait_alu_encodings.0xfffe: literal encoding with only SA_SDST==0; accepted by the verifier, never emitted by the fuzzer

required_waits.P-GETREG-MODE-THEN-MODE-WRITE: a MODE write (s_setreg_b32, s_setreg_imm32_b32, s_round_mode, s_denorm_mode) after s_getreg_b32 MODE with no s_wait_alu whose SA_SDST field is 0 (all | sa_sdst) between them is outside the profile (mode_order UNKNOWN); generation inserts that wait

wrapper_forms: multiwave.Experiment.raw_lines: m1 prologue; v_readfirstlane_b32 s20, v0; s_lshr_b32 s20, s20, 5; s_barrier_signal -1; s_barrier_wait -1; evidence reads; role mask s24/s25; s_cmp_eq_u32 s25, 1; s_cbranch_scc1 .Laggressor; victim body + stores; s_branch .Ldone; aggressor body + stores; .Ldone: evidence read; s_wait_alu 0x0; v_mov_b32 v10..v13, v1; global_store_b128 v1, v[10:13], s[2:3] offset:4*evidence_base; s_endpgm
allowlist_canonical: sha256 of json.dumps({'body','pending','wrapper','control_only'} sorted lists, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True)

wmma.operand_form: no modifiers; v[D:D+7], A, B, v[C:C+7]; A/B v[x:x+7] except fp8 16x16x128 v[x:x+15]. fuzzer typed uniform tiles: bf16 v40/v48, f16 v88/v96, iu8 v104/v112 (bytes 1, 2), fp8 e4m3 v120/v136 (1.0, 2.0; 16 VGPRs); C/D v56, v64, v72 shared by every type
wmma.output_contract: A-WMMA-EXACT-REGIME for f32 results (bf16, f16, fp8 inputs normal in their own format); A-WMMA-UNIFORM-8BIT: fp8 and iu8 evaluated only for uniform A and B tiles; iu8 unsigned (no NEG), bytes < 0x80, result inside int32; otherwise UNKNOWN

hazards.W1: D -> next WMMA A/B: f16/bf16 5, fp8 16x16x64 2, fp8 16x16x128 4, iu8 9 slots (REJECT)
hazards.W2: D -> VALU RAW/WAW, A/B/C <- VALU WAR: 4, 1, 3, 8 slots (REJECT)
hazards.W3: D -> next WMMA C, XDL WAW/WAR (unlisted): the type W1 count by conservative policy (UNKNOWN below)
hazards.W4: same-operand WMMA back-to-back without an intervening VALU/V_NOP (REJECT)
hazards.W5: slot = v_nop or a vector-ALU instruction touching none of the earlier WMMA registers, issued with EXEC != 0
hazards.W8: spacing met only by counting EXEC = 0 instructions: UNKNOWN (WMMA_EXEC0_SLOTS_UNRESOLVED)

wmma.gate: each WMMA IR key and exec0_slots stays in the campaign grammar only if its calibration probe AGREES
wmma.predecessor: none modelled by the verifier (A-NO-PREDECESSOR); predecessor configs record the hardware predecessor
wmma.operand_form_scaled: block-scaled and F8F6F4 forms: mn D, A, B, C[, SA, SB] [matrix_{a,b}_fmt:MATRIX_FMT_{BF8,FP6,BF6,FP4}] [matrix_{a,b}_scale_fmt:MATRIX_SCALE_FMT_{E5M3,E4M3}] (FP8 data and E8M0 scales are the defaults, omitted); A/B widths FP8/BF8 16, FP6/BF6 12, FP4 8 (32x128 FP4 A: 16); 32x16 C/D 16 VGPRs, in place; scale operands one VGPR (SCALE) or an even pair (SCALE16), lanes 0..15; never reuse, NEG, OP_SEL, SGPR or inline scales. fuzzer uniform tiles: bf8 v152/v168 (1.0, 4.0), fp6 v184 (4.0, contiguous 6-bit packing), bf6 v196 (1.0), fp4 v208 (1.0, 16 VGPRs)/v224 (2.0), scales E8M0 v232/v234, E5M3 v236/v238, E4M3 v240/v242 (1.0, 2.0)
wmma.output_contract_scaled: A-WMMA-UNIFORM-SMALL: block-scaled and F8F6F4 forms evaluated only for uniform A/B tiles and uniform scale tiles (layout-free D = C + K*a*b*sa*sb); elements normal or zero in their format, scales normal powers of two; A-WMMA-F6-PACKING for 6-bit tiles; exact bits under A-WMMA-EXACT-REGIME; otherwise UNKNOWN

hazards_4b.W1: D -> next WMMA A/B: bf8 16x16x64 2, bf8 16x16x128 4, f8f6f4 both F4 2, other f8f6f4 4, f4 32x16x128 4 (REJECT below)
hazards_4b.W2: D -> VALU RAW/WAW, A/B/C <- VALU WAR: 1, 3, 1, 3, 3 (REJECT below)
hazards_4b.W11: a scale operand reading an earlier WMMA D, or a VALU writing an earlier scale operand, below the count: UNKNOWN (WMMA_SCALE_SOURCE_BELOW_POLICY)
hazards_4b.W12: the 4-dword scaled form is one instruction (its LD_SCALE half is never a slot)

wmma.operand_form_sparse16: 16-bit output mn D(4), A, B, C (C 4 VGPRs; bf16f32 C 8); SWMMAC mn D, A(8), B(16), index (1 VGPR for 16-bit, an even pair for 8-bit inputs), C is D; no modifiers (no index_key, NEG, OP_SEL, reuse). fuzzer tiles: 16-bit C/D v244/v248 (F16 512+n), index v252 (0x44444444) / v254 (0xEEEEEEEE), SWMMAC B half-uniform over v88|v96 (f16), v40|v48 (bf16), v104|v112 (iu8) or the 16-VGPR fp8/bf8 tiles
wmma.output_contract_t23: F16 results exact when every partial sum is an integer below 2^11 (any accumulator of at least F16 precision); BF16 and BF16F32 results are never certified (UNKNOWN); SWMMAC evaluated only for uniform packed A, uniform or half-uniform B (A-WMMA-SPARSE-B-HALVES) and uniform index words with idx0 < idx1 in every pair: D = C + (K/4)*a*(b0+b1)

hazards_t23.W1: D -> next WMMA A/B/Index: f16/bf16 outputs 5, fp8/bf8 16x16x64 f16 output 2, 16x16x128 4; SWMMAC (16-bit, fp8/bf8) 3, SWMMAC IU8 5 (REJECT below)
hazards_t23.W2: D -> VALU RAW/WAW, A/B/C/Index <- VALU WAR: 4, 1, 3; SWMMAC 2, SWMMAC IU8 4 (REJECT below)

wmma.multiwave: Every form above may appear in aggressor waves only (victims matrix-free, admission); rules per wave as wmma/4; 16-bit C/D tiles seeded from the lane (v0 & 31) in multiwave renders, F32 C/D tiles from the work-item id (A-WMMA-CD16-LANE); VGPR budget W <= 4*floor(1024/alloc) and region <= 8192 words checked at admission

evidence_forms.s_getreg_b32 s21, hwreg(HW_REG_WAVE_HW_I: whole HW_ID1, opaque (OPAQUE words); not a MODE access, never pending

multiwave.victims: victim bodies under the same body allowlist (FP/TRANS/f16 victims stay outside: fma_bystander, trans_stale, f16_halves)
multiwave.mode_ops: pending; multiwave calibration (calibrate-family) carries no ALU MODE op probes, so MODE ops stay disabled in verified multiwave campaigns unless a later change links them
multiwave.output_contract: raw-u32-mw: slot k of wave w lane l at word k*32W + 32w + l (exact; NOT_WRITTEN beyond the wave program slot count and for twin aggressors); evidence [HW_ID1, cycles start lo, cycles end lo, wave index] per wave: index exact, the other three OPAQUE
multiwave.same_address_store_lanes: ordered by lane (evidence store data is wave-uniform)

body_macros.exec0_slots: EXEC=0 spacer (fuzzer IR op, unit NOP): s_mov_b32 exec_lo, 0; imm (1..4) x (v_nop | v_mov_b32 v81, 0); s_mov_b32 exec_lo, -1. Every rendered instruction is allowlisted; v81 is reserved scratch, never named or observed. Never a WMMA spacing slot (generation counts full-EXEC slots only; verifier W8).
